comment: The per-turn deliberate progress capability (ADR-0130), frozen across the three services it crosses, which ship in different images and share no module. The worker (apps/worker/src/curie_worker/turn_progress.py) mints a sandbox token with `token_scope` whose subject is the chain's progress_id and sends it, with the capability URL (`route` under the API base), to the runner on POST /v1/event in the two runner control headers `url_header` and `token_header`. The runner (runner/src/curie_runner/turn_progress.py) reads those headers, holds them for the open turn only, and POSTs each progress command to the URL with the token in `token_request_header`. The API (apps/api/src/curie_api/turn_progress.py) verifies the token against the path's progress_id and scope and appends the command to the chain's inbox stream at `inbox_key` (the worker's key prefix, then the progress id), one entry per command with exactly the fields of `inbox_entry_example`; the worker's pump reads that stream. Read by apps/worker/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py, runner/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py and apps/api/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py, each of which rejects an unknown key so a key added for one reader cannot pass vacuously.
